title: PhishGuard
summary: PhishGuard is a multi-tier phishing detection system combining edge ML, cloud tabular models, multimodal fusion, and an LLM arbiter, deployed as a browser extension and cloud backend. Its data pipeline uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata schema to generate synthetic tabular samples for dataset augmentation.
